profiles.name: Snake Plant
profiles.light: Bright indirect light; tolerates lower light.
profiles.watering: Allow the mix to dry before watering; drain completely.
profiles.pet_safety: Toxic to cats and dogs; prevent chewing.

profiles.name: Aglaonema
profiles.watering: Keep lightly moist, never waterlogged; allow surface drying.
profiles.pet_safety: Potentially harmful if chewed; keep away from pets.

profiles.name: Peace Lily
profiles.light: Indirect light; avoid harsh direct sun.
profiles.watering: Keep moderately moist, not saturated; check soil before watering.
profiles.pet_safety: Toxic to cats and dogs; chewing can cause oral irritation, drooling, vomiting or difficulty swallowing.

profiles.name: Schefflera
profiles.botanical_context: Heptapleurum species (formerly Schefflera); exact species unconfirmed
profiles.watering: Let the mix dry before watering thoroughly; drain well.
profiles.pet_safety: Harmful to cats and dogs if chewed.

profiles.name: Golden Palm
profiles.botanical_context: Provisionally Dypsis lutescens / Chrysalidocarpus lutescens; confirm owner stock
profiles.watering: Let the surface dry slightly; water and drain well.
profiles.pet_safety: Named areca palm is listed non-toxic to cats/dogs; confirm identity.

profiles.name: Lady Palm
profiles.botanical_context: Provisionally Rhapis excelsa; confirm owner stock
profiles.watering: Water regularly with good drainage; avoid saturated roots.
profiles.pet_safety: Named lady palm is listed non-toxic to cats/dogs; confirm identity.

profiles.name: Golden Pothos
profiles.light: Bright indirect light; tolerates lower light.
profiles.watering: Let the mix dry between waterings; drain well.
profiles.pet_safety: Harmful if chewed; keep away from pets.

profiles.name: Spider Plant
profiles.light: Indirect light; avoid strong direct sun.
profiles.watering: Keep moderately moist with drainage; avoid excessive feeding.
profiles.pet_safety: Listed non-toxic to cats/dogs; still discourage chewing.

profiles.name: Green Syngonium
profiles.watering: Keep moist but well drained; avoid soggy roots.
profiles.pet_safety: Harmful if eaten; sap can irritate.

profiles.name: Monstera
profiles.botanical_context: Monstera species; care baseline uses M. deliciosa, not confirmed identity
profiles.watering: Keep well drained and moderately moist; avoid waterlogging.
profiles.difficulty: Allow growing space and climbing support.
profiles.pet_safety: Harmful if chewed; keep away from pets.

profiles.name: Philodendron
profiles.botanical_context: Philodendron species; exact species and growth habit unconfirmed
profiles.light: Bright indirect light; avoid scorching sun.
profiles.watering: Keep well drained and moderately moist; avoid overwatering.
profiles.pet_safety: Potentially harmful if chewed; keep away from pets.

profiles.name: Pink Syngonium
profiles.botanical_context: Provisionally Syngonium podophyllum; identity/photo still held for owner review
profiles.light: Bright filtered light for variegated foliage.
profiles.watering: Keep moist but well drained; avoid soggy roots.
profiles.pet_safety: Harmful if eaten; sap can irritate.

profiles.name: Chinese Evergreen
profiles.botanical_context: Aglaonema species; overlaps the Aglaonema common-name group
profiles.watering: Keep lightly moist, never waterlogged; allow surface drying.
profiles.pet_safety: Potentially harmful if chewed; keep away from pets.

profiles.name: Calathea
profiles.botanical_context: Calathea trade group; may be Goeppertia, Ctenanthe or Stromanthe
profiles.watering: Keep evenly moist with drainage; never saturated or fully dry.
profiles.pet_safety: Named Calathea is listed non-toxic to cats/dogs; confirm exact plant.

profiles.name: N'Joy Pothos
profiles.light: Bright filtered light; shade may reduce variegation.
profiles.watering: Keep well drained; allow drying between waterings.
profiles.pet_safety: Harmful if chewed; keep away from pets.

profiles.name: Boston Fern
profiles.botanical_context: Provisionally Nephrolepis exaltata; confirm Boston-fern identity
profiles.watering: Keep the mix moist with drainage; do not let it dry completely.
profiles.difficulty: Needs humid air; check moisture regularly.
profiles.pet_safety: Named Boston fern is listed non-toxic to cats/dogs.

profiles.name: Aloe Vera
profiles.light: Bright light; suitable sun exposure after gradual adjustment.
profiles.watering: Let the mix dry completely; use freely draining succulent mix.
profiles.pet_safety: Toxic to cats and dogs; not edible advice.
